integrity: The module decomposition, invariant pairing, quadratic refinement, orbit descriptions, and addition table are derived by exact arithmetic over F_2 and reproduced by the bundled verifier. Literature overlap is explicitly separated from the refinement claimed here.
limitations: The decomposition is natural only up to swapping the two factors of O/2O. The claim is restricted to J(C)[2] for the complex Klein quartic and does not assert novelty of the previously known 7,7,21,28 orbit sizes or invariant theta characteristic.
title: The Klein quartic two-torsion is the hyperbolic \(V\oplus V^\vee\) module
